verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt exists at the general NVIDIA developer portal (HTTP 200), suggesting some agent-oriented doc discovery is possible, but this is not specific to the RTX PRO 6000 product page, and related markdown/OpenAPI endpoints for CUDA docs return 404s, showing thin, inconsistent agent-doc support. Missing for 10: product-specific llms.txt or agent docs, markdown-mirrored doc pages, and any first-party confirmation that agents are meant to consume these docs.
